Minimal necessary context and only the essential prop for the action; no unrelated objects and no second person or animal. No text, letters, numerals, logos, brands, signatures, speech bubbles, music notes or watermarks, including on clothing, books and screens. Books and writing/drawing supports can be blank; use at most simple non-symbolic marks. No collage or multiple panels. Correct natural anatomy, no extra limbs. School-friendly, no violence, horror or frightening expression. Vary human appearance naturally across the series; this subject's skin tone should be medium brown. Photo children fully and ordinarily clothed. One image only; clearly teach the named subject and action.
